features.note: Test default shader features include the non-default diagnostic ssao-stage-readback; the build records the actual compiler-artifact features and refuses any other set.

frame_rule: One charged frame = one call that encodes a scene graph, display/output pass, text or UI pass, compute cluster grid, retained submit or composed game tick, including refused attempts. Readbacks/copies are not frames. Existing-test bounds are static counts from source review; helper cases count actual calls in-process and refuse beyond their declaration.

analysis.note: Numerical gates and the original quality gates (N6 authored, N7, N8 stripes ROI) are all recorded; the predicted N6 and N8-perspective failures are reported as failed quality, never as a device-work failure. N6T is a diagnostic.

timeouts_basis: Watchdogs, not measurements; their sum (1290 s) stays under the 2700 s ceiling.

environment.spawn_gate: The leader starts as this Python interpreter (-I -S -B) blocked on a pipe; its exact identity is recorded before the runner sends the exact environment, and only then does it exec the program. A gate that never opens exits 125.

shared_gpu_lock.protocol: flock(2) LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB, taken before the grant preflight and the packet lock and held through reservation, launch, kill+wait, completion and unlock; released by closing, never LOCK_UN; device children inherit the descriptor. Other packets must flock the same path to be excluded.

sequence: python3 -I -B handoffs/0070-ambient-occlusion/ssao-filter-001/filter_runner.py release --grant <evidence>/gpu-grant.json   (always, also after any failure)
